name: CheckboxField
description: Single checkbox wired to a label and optional helper text. Distinct from `Checkbox` (the unwrapped primitive) — `CheckboxField` is the form-row composition with `Label` + `HelperText` already attached.

ariaRequirements: Renders a native `<input type='checkbox'>` linked to the label via `htmlFor` / `id`.
`indeterminate` is set imperatively on mount when the prop is true; the visual matches.
`error` exposes the helper text as `role='alert'` on form submit.
